# Technource

> > Custom AI software development company specializing in mobile apps, NLP, chatbots, data engineering, and digital transformation solutions.

Technource is a global software development firm with offices in Ahmedabad (India), Wilmington (Delaware, USA), and Sherwood Park (Alberta, Canada), led by Sanjay Singh Rajpurohit and Chetan Patel. The company delivers custom software solutions using technologies like Flutter, React Native, Kotlin, JavaScript, PHP, and AI/ML frameworks across mobile (Android/iOS), web, and enterprise platforms.

## Key Topics

- AI & Machine Learning Solutions
- Natural Language Processing (NLP)
- Mobile App Development (Android, iOS, Flutter, React Native)
- Custom Software Development
- AI Chatbot Development
- Data Engineering & ETL Pipelines
- DevOps Automation & CI/CD
- Industrial IoT (IIoT)
- Staff Augmentation
- Trading & Investment Apps
- eCommerce & Business Automation
- Agile Methodology
- Digital Transformation
- App Optimization & Performance
- Consulting Services
